_comment: Workspace settings the coordinator plugin and the release read. `integration` is the branch every plan branches from and the release merges into. `resources` names the shared machines and services that parallel plans must take one at a time through lock_take, for example a deployed instance or a worker machine. `locked_commands` maps one of those resources to the shell patterns it guards and the two comments the hook gives an agent: `comment_free` when the lock is free, `comment_held` when another session holds it. A matching shell command is refused until the session or an ancestor holds the lock.
